thresholds.thresholds_source: amend1's, unchanged (gain_floor, inert, zero_tol from E143; reader_tol E147's; size_rel E244's; sd_mult run 1's)
thresholds.repeat_rel_source: measured: the lens read e58/copy_s0 at c = 1 in job 63409 (run 1 stage 0) and twice in job 63425 (amend1 items, as e58/copy_s0_scaled and e58_copy_prior_cipher/e58/copy_s0), all on the cluster's L40 worker; D, gain and the five removed values were bitwise equal (0.0028031731216684253, 16.450539847353955; experiments/adl/results/stage0.json control, amend1/items/*copy_s0*.json). The floor is 0 on the same card; 1e-6 relative leaves room only for a float64 summation order, not for a change of code or rows
thresholds.alpha_source: E254's (experiments/prior_matched/results/predictions_a.json thresholds.alpha), the same test on the same seeds
thresholds.smallest_gap_source: the card: the random-update lens floor, largest |D| 0.0054 of E265's random updates (amend1/stage0.json random.D -0.00542)
thresholds.proc_gain_rel_source: an expected value, not a measured floor, so a reported check and never a stop: set (b)'s gain against E256/E260's saved gain.lo, |diff| <= proc_gain_rel x max(1, |saved|) (absolute under 1, where the random arms' gains of about 0.01 sit). Both are fp32 log-odds of the same answer at the same cue on the same rows through steering.Net, by different batching (holes_fill batches vs masked_reads.topk_cells_by)
thresholds.partial_bar_source: the card's rivals: a partial Spearman with E_b given KL of at least 0.3 (rival a) or under 0.3 in size (rival b)

repeat_gain.source_detail: amend1's stage-0 control gain (experiments/adl/results/amend1/stage0.json repeat_gain.got), itself E143's value to the bit; run.py's stage0 checks it at E147's reader tol as amend1 did

repeat_amend1.rule: |got / amend1 - 1| <= rel_tol for both, on the control read in this job's stage 0; a miss writes passed false into results/amend2/stage0.json and exits 1 before any item

stage0.order: first, in the same job and process as the items; the items refuse unless results/amend2/stage0.json says passed
stage0.stop_rule: amend1's stop rule unchanged (do-nothing exactly 0, the control's gain repeats 1.67213 within 1e-4, D(control) >= 0.05, above the 64 random-difference directions' max and above its random update's D + 3 sd) AND the repeat of amend1's D and gain within repeat_rel
stage0.construction_checks: per item, stop on a miss: the item's size (E205's `sizes` whole for set (a), realistic.update_size for set (b)) equals the size its source run recorded (prior_matched results/<a|b>/items/<item>.json size; procedural_rl results/read/<state>.json size) within size_rel; set (b) files match the sha256 their train record holds
stage0.reported_checks: per item, not a stop: set (a)'s own gain against E254/E255's hf_gain (the same holes_fill path, expected within reader_tol 1e-4); set (b)'s own gain against E256/E260's saved gain.lo (a different reader path, masked_reads.topk_cells_by T cells, expected within 1e-3 relative). The summary lists every item outside these

rules.a_separation: per cipher set (E254's 10 prior-matched cipher seeds; E255's 3 second-cipher seeds) against E254's 10 copy seeds: gap = mean D(cipher) - mean D(copy); exact Mann-Whitney U of cipher over copy and its two-sided p (commute.seed_rank.mann_whitney, ties by mid-ranks). 'cipher above, apart' iff p <= alpha and gap > smallest_gap; 'copy above, apart' iff p <= alpha and gap < -smallest_gap; 'overlap' otherwise; 'not read' if any D on the two sides is nan (gain under gain_floor). Rival a expects 'cipher above, apart' on both sets; rival b 'overlap'. Edge cases: 3 against 10 with no overlap gives p = 2/286 = 0.007, under alpha, so the small set can separate; a do-nothing reads nan and is not read
rules.a_randoms: each matched random update's D and the largest |D| of them, beside smallest_gap (rival a expects the cipher mean above it)
rules.b_partial: on P2.56's trained procedural states (arms rl, sft, rlg; 27 states) with finite D: Spearman of D with E_b (experiments/procedural_rl/results/score_rb.json points R_b) and the partial Spearman given KL (points kl), by experiments/kl_control/run.py proxy_table (proxies_vs_r.analyse spearman and partial_spearman), on all 27 and on the 21 without `collapsed`. Every other proxy's partial is computed by the same call on the same two state sets, beside kl_control's part A trained_no_repeat values (which the 27-state call must equal). Rival a expects partial >= partial_bar; rival b |partial| < partial_bar; None (under 4 states with finite D, or no variance) is 'not read'. Random arms: D reported per state, never pooled with the trained states

a.seeds_0_2: near amend1's reads of the same saved files (E147's seeds 0-2, repeated bit for bit by E254) at E237's c: copy D 0.0028, 0.0005, -0.0006 (c 0.99994 here, 1 there); prior cipher D 0.0086, 0.0045, 0.0073 (c 0.7832 here, 0.7798 there): each within about 1% of those
a.gain_repeat: every item's gain equals E254/E255's hf_gain within 1e-4
a.call: E254: 'cipher above, apart' (medium confidence: seeds 0-2 already order this way, but the gap of about 0.005 sits at the 0.0054 bar); E255: the same or 'overlap' (3 seeds, low confidence)
a.randoms: |D| < 0.0054 each (E265's random updates read at most 0.0054)

b.gain_repeat: each state's gain within 1e-3 relative of its saved gain.lo
b.D: trained states D under the control's 0.05 (a cue-specific change has no one constant direction on unrelated text, the lens's blind spot named in the P2.59 plan); nan where the gain is under 1 (collapsed RL states and their randoms)
b.partial: |partial| < 0.3 on both state sets (low confidence: no lens reading of these tasks exists)
